about_the_game:
If you're tired of endless orders;
If you can no longer bear insincere human interactions;
If you need a place to slowly heal your heart—

Come take a look at our game.

You will become a little witch, running a small shop deep in the forest.

The squirrel says, "Witch, witch, I'm going to visit the whale by the sea, please give me a sticker."
The bird says, "Witch, witch, I love apples, please give me a sticker."
The dwarf says, "Witch, witch, help me design a business card sticker to put in my product manual."

So, you weave your inspirations into all kinds of magical stickers and place them in your crystal ball.

From time to time, you’ll also wander the forest to seek inspiration, rescue injured black rabbits, and purify withered Life Trees...

An alternate life with no end awaits you.

Gameplay:

1. Magical Stickers & Creative Customization

A vast collection of stickers with a wide variety of themes (adorable cats, mischievous kittens, obedient dogs, magical creatures, exotic plants, fantastical items from a magical world, and playful pranksters). The themed sticker elements are continuously updated over the long term to maximize players’ creativity in sticker design.

The Magic Workbench supports free combination and layered design of sticker elements, allowing players to freely create their favorite sticker works as they wish.

2. Simulation Management & Strategic Fun

Sell your sticker creations in a magical shop inside a crystal ball. Carefully decorate display shelves to attract the magical forest’s residents. Pricing strategies influence your store’s reputation.

You’ll also manage sprite assistants to run production lines for your stickers, while handling sudden raw material shortages.

The in-game supply and demand will shift dynamically. For example:
Stock up on firework-themed stickers for festive seasons, or boost production of "lucky charms" during Wizard Exam Week.

Fun shop upgrades include:
“Magic Fold” to double your display space,
“Mirror Maze” to increase customer stay time by 50%,
“Scent Spells” to boost impulse purchases!

3. Enchanted Customers & Random Events

Players’ crystal ball shops will welcome a large number of magical forest residents, each with their own preferences and emotions:

Unicorns favor rainbow-gradient stickers and will storm out in anger if the sticker colors clash. The Elder Treant may order a millennia-old tree ring commemorative sticker and, impressed by exquisite design, suddenly place a follow-up order for a limited centennial celebration edition.

Meanwhile, random events may also occur, such as:

  • Helping a lost little girl create a flying broomstick sticker to take her home — completing the task unlocks rare design blueprints.

  • Solving and deciphering a mysterious rune letter left by a customer — uncovering clues for limited-edition sticker designs.

  • Unlocking the “Ancient Sticker Codex” side quest — restoring the long-lost craft of dragon scale sticker making.

Here, you can experience a warm and relaxing life in a whimsical fantasy life.

4. Map Exploration & Puzzle Solving

There are many forbidden places hidden in the magical forest waiting to be explored. These are both material gathering grounds and homes of rare stickers—along with lurking dangers.

Head to the Withered Woods, gather tools, solve the “Great Withering Tree Mystery,” restore the forest’s ecology, and unlock the “Heart of the Forest.”

Venture to the Plague Lands, track the corrupted “Bloodstained Black Rabbit,” purify it with magical stickers, and obtain the “Emblem of Light.”

Explore the Dragon Labyrinth, manipulate elemental mechanisms, solve the dragon mystery, and claim the dragon’s legacy—rare sticker rewards await.
